text:
Lia Chen: Quick sync — finish-line checklist for GA acceptance. Need clear owners for SLA, docs, support runbook, monitoring alarms, pricing page, and pilot customer comms. Can we close this by EOD tomorrow?
Matt R: Agree. SLA draft ready, but need final numbers from eng & finops. Can we set p95 token latency SLO and an availability SLA? Suggest 99.95 availability for hosted API.
Kevin S: 99.95 availability seems ok for Hosted. For p95, set 250ms/token for small models, 600ms/token for large models as provisional. We'll validate with perf tests tomorrow morning.
Sumi G: Docs: I can land the quickstart and migration guide if you give final SLA language. Also need screenshots for Console alerting flow.
Ana (finops): Pricing page needs unit cost estimate after batching/quant recommendations. Can we get per-1k-token cost delta from Optimize team by EOD?
Lia Chen: Owners: SLA -> Matt, Eng validation -> Kevin, Docs -> Sumi, Pricing numbers -> Ana, Runbook & oncall -> OpsBot/Kevin. If anyone can't, speak now.
Kevin S: Noted. We'll run the perf matrix against dedicated and hosted variants at 9am and post results in this thread.
Matt R: I'll draft SLA blurb: "Hosted API: 99.95% monthly uptime; p95 token latency under specified model profiles; SLOs exclude scheduled maintenance and customer-side network issues." Ping if wording problematic.
Sumi G: That wording is fine. One ask: add a short explainer paragraph about fallback behavior when capacity is constrained (model variants & automatic fallback) so customers understand graceful degradation.
Matt R: Good call. I'll add a fallback section.
OpsBot: @Lia Chen — created runbook draft at https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ga-launch. Added placeholder escalation chain and symmetric fallbacks. :robot_face:
Lia Chen: Nice, OpsBot. Kevin — can you validate pager noise risk? We need to cap noisy alerts before GA.
Kevin S: We'll add anomaly suppression and group alerts. Proposal: only page on sustained error rate > 1% over 5m or system overhead > 80% for 2m. That should reduce false positives.
Ana (finops): For pricing, current projection: $0.35 per 1k tokens (hosted baseline) before discounts; with quantization + batching we see potential drop to $0.12 per 1k tokens. Need confirmation from Optimize team.
Sumi G: Docs/marketing asks: include sample SLA text and a short migration checklist for Dedicated customers. I'll draft both if SLA text final.
Lia Chen: Action items recap: Matt finalize SLA text (owner), Kevin post perf matrix + alert tuning, Sumi draft docs + migration checklist, Ana confirm pricing delta, OpsBot finalize runbook + oncall. Target: signoff tomorrow EOD. Anyone object?
Kevin S: No objections.
Matt R: ack
Sumi G: ack
Ana (finops): ack
Lia Chen: Great — let's keep updates in this thread. If we hit blockers, we'll escalate to product leadership. :raised_hands:
OpsBot: Deployment window note: GA cutover scheduled tentatively for 2025-06-15 pending signoffs.
Matt R: Added a TODO for legal on SLA terms and reimbursement limits. Will loop legal tomorrow.
Lia Chen: Thanks all — short sync tomorrow 9:30 to confirm perf and pricing. Closing thread until then unless urgent.
